items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Killman puts in a thing like that sometimes.

ctx.x: See, like I said, come right on down with that note. Like these fellas, there's a number of, there plays around here. We play it all the time.
Killman puts in a thing like that sometimes. Lead and Savvy?
Yeah. I heard nobody else play that thing since Eddie died. That's right.
